rpa-p01-v01.quick_english: At god's hour, surrender to the Lord; then stillness, restraint, and the twilight rite. Two watches of muttering-and-worship, then the rest is session; what remains of time is conduct as Śiva's remainder.

rpa-p01-v02.quick_english: A-first-faced, KA-handed, ṬA-footed, PĀ-sided with ṂA-middle; YA-hearted goddess, consciousness-formed — Sarasvatī wins.

rpa-p01-v03.quick_english: Thought-jewel, wish-cow, wish-tree bear fruit, men's desires and no more. Unasked, unheaped, nourish man's aims, O mother's noble mood.

rpa-p01-v04.quick_english: Without whom nothing at all is done, nothing known, nothing wanted — by the lord of awareness: to her, the highest, the worlds' mother — homage to Śivā, Śiva's beloved.

rpa-p01-v05.quick_english: Ever-risen, blessed, all-auspicious, Śiva-giving, dwelling in Śiva's heart, O Śivā — moonlight opening the night-lotus for the worshipping mind: twice-born, make my going in heaven supreme.

rpa-p01-v06.quick_english: Be gracious, all-auspicious Śivā, Śiva's beloved. Umā, Ramā, Sarasvatī — you alone are the supreme goddess.

rpa-p01-v07.quick_english: O mother, O Ambikā, formless, nameless, Umā, Raudrī, Vāmā, Mahālakṣmī, Māyā; supreme goddess sporting the five acts, auspicious Bhairavī, glorious — I surrender to you.

rpa-p01-v08.quick_english: Māyā, Vidyā, Mātṛkā, Mālinī — you throb in every body as awareness-spark-self. How shall I meditate you self-flashing? I meditate you as inward-resounding speech.

rpa-p02-v09.quick_english: In the skin-blood-flesh-fat-marrow-bone-bodied, ever-deluded body — Māyā, you plunge folk, knowing and unknowing, who know not your greatness.

rpa-p02-v10.quick_english: Gods set up in metal-drawn images — seeing them, 'hā hā alas' say the unfulfilled. For body-dwellers proud with body-I-ness — what delusion does Māyā not birth?

rpa-p02-v11.quick_english: From all that is born of delusion-play-arisen voided-intellect, body-and-all I-ness — protect me from falling, supreme goddess, whose form is self-awareness born of effort.

rpa-p02-v12.quick_english: Terrible-natured, most terrible, non-terrible; called higher-and-lower, neither lower nor higher; seeing Śiva's manifold power, abiding in wonder.

rpa-p02-v13.quick_english: Dwelling mid the rays of higher-and-lower: no insistence of mine on being-judgments, nonbeing-judgments, being-nonbeing-judgments.

rpa-p02-v14.quick_english: Your unsurpassed form flashes, and the other world-made one, O mother: remembering both — to the good, fear-giving, boon-giving, supreme goddess.

rpa-p02-v15.quick_english: Lady of the five acts, supreme-knowing-formed Pārvatī, be gracious: lift the fallen beast-fettered one; soothe the child with cool glances.

rpa-p02-v16.quick_english: Having bowed to perfected gurus, gods, goddess, then yogins — by Abhinavagupta these fifteen verses were uttered.

rpa-p01-v01.speaker: Poet (dawn-rite)
rpa-p01-v01.question: How does the day begin?
premises: At god's hour, surrender to the Lord; then stillness, restraint, twilight rite.
Two watches of muttering-and-worship, then other session; remainder of time as Śiva's remainder-conduct.
rpa-p01-v01.inference: The dawn sequence orders the whole day: surrender first, then stillness, restraint, twilight; two watches given to muttering-and-worship, all remaining time conducted as Śiva's remainder.

rpa-p01-v02.speaker: Poet (letter-goddess)
rpa-p01-v02.question: Who is enthroned?
premises: A-first-faced, KA-handed, ṬA-footed, PĀ-sided with ṂA-middle.
YA-hearted goddess, consciousness-formed — Sarasvatī wins.
rpa-p01-v02.inference: The letter-body enthroned as goddess: alphabet limbs from A to YA, consciousness-formed Sarasvatī supreme over all.

rpa-p01-v03.speaker: Poet (wish-powers)
rpa-p01-v03.question: What bears fruit unasked?
premises: Thought-jewel, wish-cow, wish-trees bear fruit — men's desires and no more.
Unasked, unheaped, nourish man's aims, O mother's noble mood.
rpa-p01-v03.inference: The wish-powers grant only the wished: unasked, unpiled, let the mother's noble mood nourish man's aims.

rpa-p01-v04.speaker: Poet (supreme śakti)
rpa-p01-v04.question: Without whom nothing?
premises: Without whom nothing at all is done, nothing known, nothing wanted — by the awareness-lord.
To her, the highest, the worlds' mother — homage to Śivā, Śiva's beloved.
rpa-p01-v04.inference: Awareness-lordship as precondition of all doing, knowing, wanting: homage to her as highest, worlds' mother, Śiva's beloved.

rpa-p01-v05.speaker: Poet (moonlight)
rpa-p01-v05.question: What is asked at moonrise?
premises: Ever-risen, blessed, all-auspicious, Śiva-giving, in-Śiva's-heart-dwelling, O Śivā.
Moonlight opening night-lotus for the worshipping mind: twice-born, make my going in heaven supreme.
rpa-p01-v05.inference: Moonlight-prayer for the twice-born mind: opened like night-lotus, made to go supreme in heaven.

rpa-p01-v06.speaker: Poet (litany)
rpa-p01-v06.question: Who alone is supreme?
premises: Be gracious, all-auspicious Śivā, Śiva's beloved.
Umā, Ramā, Sarasvatī — you alone are the supreme goddess.
rpa-p01-v06.inference: Direct address collapsing names into one: Umā, Ramā, Sarasvatī — you alone the supreme goddess.

rpa-p01-v07.speaker: Poet (fierce forms)
rpa-p01-v07.question: To whom surrender?
premises: O mother, Ambikā, formless, nameless, Umā, Raudrī, Vāmā, Mahālakṣmī, Māyā.
Supreme goddess sporting the five acts, auspicious Bhairavī, glorious — I surrender to you.
rpa-p01-v07.inference: Fierce-form litany gathered into surrender: formless, nameless, many-named — five-act-sporting Bhairavī.

rpa-p01-v08.speaker: Poet (throbbing)
rpa-p01-v08.question: How is she meditated?
premises: Māyā, Vidyā, Mātṛkā, Mālinī — you throb in every body as awareness-spark-self.
How shall I meditate you self-flashing? I meditate you as inward-resounding speech.
rpa-p01-v08.inference: Throbbing-in-every-body as the meditation object: self-flashing answered by inward-resounding speech.
uncertainties: Print reads mālini (kept); reference books cite mānini — Tantraloka 15.333 supports mālinī; single surface, no live fork.

rpa-p02-v09.speaker: Poet (body-churn)
rpa-p02-v09.question: Whom does Māyā plunge?
premises: In the skin-blood-flesh-fat-marrow-bone-bodied, ever-deluded body.
Māyā, you plunge knowing-and-unknowing folk who know not your greatness.
rpa-p02-v09.inference: The body catalogued as delusion's house; knowing and unknowing alike plunged for not knowing her greatness.

rpa-p02-v10.speaker: Poet (set-up gods)
rpa-p02-v10.question: What of set-up gods?
premises: Gods set up in metal-drawn images — seeing them, 'hā hā alas' say the unfulfilled.
For body-dwellers proud with body-I-ness — what delusion does Māyā not birth.
rpa-p02-v10.inference: Installed images leave seers unfulfilled: body-I-ness breeds every delusion.

rpa-p02-v11.speaker: Poet (protection)
rpa-p02-v11.question: What protects from falling?
premises: From delusion-play-arisen voided-intellect, body-and-all I-ness-born all.
Protect from falling, supreme goddess, self-awareness-formed through effort.
rpa-p02-v11.inference: Protection-begging from the all born of delusion-play: effort-born self-awareness as the guard against falling.

rpa-p02-v12.speaker: Poet (wonder)
rpa-p02-v12.question: How is power beheld?
premises: Terrible-natured, most terrible, non-terrible; higher-and-lower-called, neither lower nor higher.
Manifold-formed Śiva's power — seeing it, abiding in wonder.
rpa-p02-v12.inference: Beholding the manifold power — terrible and not — ends in wonder-abiding, not doctrine.

rpa-p02-v13.speaker: Poet (no-insistence)
rpa-p02-v13.question: What insistence remains?
premises: Dwelling mid the rays of higher-and-lower.
No insistence of mine on being-nonbeing-being-nonbeing judgments.
rpa-p02-v13.inference: Mid-ray dwelling dissolves insistence: no grip on any being-nonbeing judgment.

rpa-p02-v14.speaker: Poet (both remembered)
rpa-p02-v14.question: What is remembered?
premises: Your unsurpassed form flashes, and the other world-made one, O mother.
Remembering both — to the good, fear-giving, boon-giving, supreme goddess.
rpa-p02-v14.inference: Both forms remembered together: unsurpassed and world-made — to the good, fear and boon from one goddess.

rpa-p02-v15.speaker: Poet (five acts)
rpa-p02-v15.question: What is asked of the five-act lady?
premises: Lady of the five acts, supreme-knowing-formed Pārvatī, be gracious.
Lift the fallen beast-fettered one; soothe the child with cool glances.
rpa-p02-v15.inference: Double petition: lift the fallen fettered one; soothe the child — cool glances for heat.

rpa-p02-v16.speaker: Poet (seal)
rpa-p02-v16.question: Who utters these?
premises: Having bowed to perfected gurus, gods, goddess, then yogins.
By Abhinavagupta these fifteen verses uttered.
rpa-p02-v16.inference: Lineage-bow then authorship claim: perfected ones first, then the fifteen verses as Abhinavagupta's uttering.

rasa.dominant: adbhuta with bhakti (wonder held in devotion)
rasa.sthayibhava: vismaya with rati (wonder with loving attachment)
rasa.justification: The body revealed as temple and alphabet as goddess: wonder at the ordinary made divine, carried by repeated address. Praise that beholds, then asks, then surrenders.

sections.SUMMARY: Dawn sequence orders the day: surrender, stillness, restraint, twilight; two watches for muttering-and-worship, the rest as Śiva's remainder. Letter-body enthroned as goddess: alphabet limbs from A to YA, consciousness-formed Sarasvatī supreme. Wish-powers grant only the wished: unasked, unpiled, the mother's noble mood nourishes man's aims. Awareness-lordship preconditions all doing, knowing, wanting: homage as highest, worlds' mother, Śiva's beloved. Moonlight-prayer for the twice-born mind: night-lotus-opened, made to go supreme in heaven. Direct address collapsing names into one: Umā, Ramā, Sarasvatī — you alone supreme. Fierce-form litany gathered into surrender: formless, nameless, many-named — five-act-sporting Bhairavī. Throbbing-in-every-body as meditation object: self-flashing answered by inward-resounding speech.
sections.FUNCTION: Sets the day in order, enthrones letters as goddess, and turns every sense-power toward surrender.
sections.KEY TERMS: brāhma-muhūrta (god's-hour as practice-gate); mātṛkā (letters as limbs); puṣṇātu (nourish as the only request); saṃvidīśa (awareness-lord as precondition); kumuda-candrikā (night-lotus-moonlight as opening); pañcakṛtya (five acts as her sport); spandase (you-throb as meditation object).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Dawn rite done, goddess enthroned, wishes bounded, awareness owned, moonlight asked, names one, forms surrendered, throbbing meditated.
sections.BOUNDARY: Nothing is explained yet; every verse addresses, nothing concludes.
sections.EXPLANATION: The day is divided before anything is said: surrender at god's hour, then stillness, restraint, twilight, two watches of work, and all the rest conducted as Śiva's remainder. Then the alphabet itself stands up as goddess — limbs lettered A to YA, consciousness-formed, winning. The wish-powers are bounded at once: only the wished, unasked and unpiled, and even that through the mother's mood. All doing, knowing, wanting is shown preconditioned on awareness herself, so homage goes to her as highest. Moonlight is asked to open the mind like a night-lotus. Many names collapse to one supreme. Fierce forms — Raudrī, Vāmā, Mahālakṣmī — gather without contradiction into surrender. And the practice lands in the body: she throbs in every body, self-flashing, and the answer to how-to-meditate is inward-resounding speech.
sections.RELATED: Dyczkowski two-part blog (gatekeeper ascriptions generalized to daily rite here); abhinavagupta.org hymns page (The Goddess Within, lineage English); Sharada ms (Jammu No 67) different transmission — noted, not collated.

sections.FUNCTION: Contemplates the body as delusion's house, refuses substitutes, and ends in petition and bowed head.
sections.KEY TERMS: māhātmya (greatness as what the plunged do not know); lohālekhya (metal-drawn images as unfulfilling); ātma-vimarśa (self-awareness as guard); vismaya (wonder as beholding's end); abhidā (being-nonbeing judgments as released grip); kaṭākṣa (cool glances as grace).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Surrender made, throbbing meditated: now the body inventoried, images refused, protection begged, power wondered at, judgments dropped, both forms held, child soothed, line bowed to.
sections.BOUNDARY: No siddhi is claimed; petition stays open-ended.
sections.EXPLANATION: The second movement inventories the body tissue by tissue — skin to marrow — and names it delusion's house, into which knowing and unknowing alike are plunged for missing her greatness. Set-up gods in metal fail their seers: with body-I-ness intact, every delusion breeds. So protection is begged from the all born of delusion-play, with effort-born self-awareness as guard. Then beholding itself: terrible, more terrible, non-terrible — power manifold — and the seer ends abiding in wonder, not in a thesis. Mid-ray dwelling drops every insistence on being or nonbeing judgments. Both her forms are remembered at once — unsurpassed and world-made — giving fear and boon to the good. The close petitions twice: lift the fallen fettered one, soothe the child with cool glances. Last, the lineage bow and the authorship claim: fifteen verses, uttered by Abhinavagupta.
sections.RELATED: Dyczkowski per-verse exposition (petal structure generalized to sense-offerings here); Sharada ms different transmission — noted, not collated; v16 attribution to Abhinavagupta — ending in his own name.

lines: Ever-risen, blessed, all-blissful, Śiva-giving, heart-homed in Śiva, O Śivā —
night-lotus-opening moonlight: to the worshipping mind, make my heaven-going supreme.
rpa-p01-v05.sanskrit_cite: sadodite bhagavati sarvamaṅgale | śivaprade śivahṛdayasthite śive | bhajanmanaḥ kumudavikāsacandrike | dvijanmanaḥ kuru mama khe gatiṃ pare

lines: Favor us, all-blissful Śivā, Śiva's beloved —

lines: Mother! Formless Ambikā, nameless — Umā, Raudrī, Vāmā the leftward, great Lakṣmī, Māyā:
supreme goddess playing the five acts, gracious Bhairavī, glorious — I go to you.

lines: Māyā, Vidyā, Mātṛkā, Mālinī — pulsing in each body as knowing's own spark:
how dwell on you, self-flashing? I dwell on you as inward-murmuring speech.

lines: In flesh-skin-blood-fat-marrow-bone frame, ever ailing —

lines: Gods installed in metal-pictures — seeing them, 'alas, alas' cry the unfulfilled:
body-proud body-bearers — what folly does Māyā not mother?
rpa-p02-v10.sanskrit_cite: lohālekhyasthāpitān vīkṣya devān | hā hā hantetyāhureke'kṛtārthāḥ | dehāhantāśālināṃ dehabhājāṃ | mohāveśaṃ kaṃ na māyā prasūte

lines: From the all born of play-arisen, voided-mind, body-and-all I-making —
keep me from falling, supreme goddess, self-knowing-formed through striving.

manifold-formed, Śiva's power: beholding, I rest in wonder.

lines: Mid-rayed in high-and-low — no clutch of mine on is-is-not-is-not sayings.

both held in mind — to the good, fear-giver, boon-giver, highest goddess.
